CORAM:
HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJNESH OSWAL, JUDGE  ORDER 07-05-2025 1.

The appeal (LPAOW No. 64/2016) preferred by the predecessor-in- interest of the petitioner,
namely, Lt. Shri Satpal Gupta, was allowed by the Coordinate Bench vide order and judgment dated 29.08.2022, and the judgment rendered by the learned Single Judge, impugned therein, was set aside.
For the proceedings initiated in the year 1993, vide notification dated 26.02.1993 under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, had since lapsed in view of the proviso to Section 11-B of the Act.

Accordingly, it was concluded that the respondents would initiate fresh proceedings under the J&K Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, within one month.

entities.text: J&K Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: And shall conclude the process within the period prescribed under the 2013 Act.

2. In essence, the grievance of the petitioner is that although nearly three years have gone by, but the matter has not made any tangible progress.
3.

Ms. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG., appearing for the respondent Nos. 2 and 5, has shared with Mudit Gupta vs H Rajesh Prasad on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164049292/
1 us a copy of the communication dated 03.05.2025, whereby the Assistant Commissioner Revenue,
Jammu, has issued a letter of indent qua land measuring 06 Kanals and 15 Marlas for construction of a Data Recovery Centre at Gladni Grid Station, Narwal, Jammu.

entities.text: Mudit Gupta vs H Rajesh Prasad
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
A copy of the said communication is retained on record and marked as 'X'.
4.
Accordingly, she submits that the proceedings for acquisition in terms of the 2013 Act are now to be initiated by the Collector, Land Acquisition, 220 KV, PDD, Jammu.

5. For, prima facie, there is a willful non-compliance of the order dated 21.08.2024 by the respondent-authorities, she prays for a short accommodation to ascertain as to the precise time the competent authority would require to initiate the acquisition proceedings, before we proceed any further with the present contempt petition.

(RAJNESH OSWAL) (ARUN PALLI)
 JUDGE CHIEF JUSTICE SRINAGAR 07-05-2025 Junaid Mudit Gupta vs H Rajesh Prasad on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164049292/
